scenario.name: Successful recovery (seed 13)
scenario.tagline: Degradation detected, SJF selected, observation window accepts it
scenario.description: The 'mixed' generator workload at seed 13 under the waiting-time recovery rule. The controller detects degradation, switches FCFS to SJF and keeps SJF when the observation window closes with an accepted residual.
scenario.expectation: Verification closes accepted; SJF stays in force to the end of the trace.

healing.summary: Verification closed accepted (verified_phase_residual): the residual +0.4375 reached the accept boundary +0.30, so SJF stayed in force.

stages.title: Normal scheduling
stages.detail: FCFS dispatches the trace until the incident at t=243: 6 recorded intervals before it.

stages.title: Monitoring
stages.detail: Rolling statistic over 6 completed processes: mean 105.17, median 105.00, maximum 203.00; stable reference 63.75 with dispersion band 9.56.

stages.title: Degradation detected
stages.detail: The window mean 105.17 exceeded the threshold 75.70 = reference 63.75 + 9.56-unit band x the declared multiplier, for 2 consecutive evaluations. Detector reason: degradation_detected.

stages.title: Diagnosis
stages.detail: fairness_starvation: oldest ready job has waited at least 233 time units (recent completed-work wait 105.2 vs reference 63.8 (band 9.6, window 6 completions); also matched: priority_ordering_anomaly, fairness_starvation, queue_congestion) Matched categories: priority_ordering_anomaly,fairness_starvation,queue_congestion. Visible remaining work at the trigger: 245 units.

stages.title: Selected intervention
stages.detail: Offered actions: hold,set_sjf,set_round_robin,set_priority. Chosen: set_sjf (predeclared_waiting_time_rule: declared action for diagnosis fairness_starvation). Action note: policy changed. Configuration: FCFS q=4 -> SJF q=4.

stages.title: Observation window
stages.detail: The window closed after 5 decisions and 5 completions.

stages.title: Verification
stages.detail: Verdict accepted; reason verified_phase_residual. Closure fraction 2.486 against the expected no-action closure 2.049; residual +0.4375. Declared boundaries: accept at or above +0.30, reject at or below -0.30, otherwise inconclusive.

stages.title: Final decision
stages.detail: SJF kept in force. Confirmed failure: False. Consecutive confirmed failures: 0. Safe fallback triggered: False. Post-window dispatches: 4; final policy SJF. Reward +0.0708; charged cost 0.0667 band units.
